module_summary: AXI4 clock-domain crossing bridge that carries each AW, W, B, AR and R channel through its own asynchronous dual-clock FIFO, deriving valid/ready from FIFO empty/full flags.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWADDR
anchors.why: Slave write address packed into the AW async FIFO.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Slave write data packed into the W async FIFO.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARADDR
anchors.why: Slave read address packed into the AR async FIFO.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Read data delivered to slave clock domain from R async FIFO.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: AW valid; with AWREADY forms write strobe of AW FIFO.

anchors.name: S_AXI_AWREADY
anchors.why: AW ready derived from not-full of the AW FIFO.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WREADY
anchors.why: W ready derived from not-full of the W FIFO.

anchors.name: S_AXI_BVALID
anchors.why: B response valid derived from not-empty of the B FIFO.

anchors.name: S_AXI_RVALID
anchors.why: Read valid derived from not-empty of the R FIFO.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WDATA
anchors.why: Write data read out of W FIFO in master clock domain.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RDATA
anchors.why: Downstream read data written into the R async FIFO.

anchors.name: mreset
anchors.why: Three-stage reset synchronizer generating M_AXI_ARESETN in master clock domain.

anchors.name: S_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: W valid gating W FIFO write.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: AR valid gating AR FIFO write.

anchors.name: S_AXI_ARREADY
anchors.why: AR ready from not-full of AR FIFO.

anchors.name: M_AXI_AWVALID
anchors.why: Master AW valid from not-empty of AW FIFO.

anchors.name: M_AXI_WVALID
anchors.why: Master W valid from not-empty of W FIFO.

anchors.name: M_AXI_BREADY
anchors.why: Master B ready from not-full of B FIFO.

anchors.name: M_AXI_ARVALID
anchors.why: Master AR valid from not-empty of AR FIFO.

anchors.name: M_AXI_RREADY
anchors.why: Master R ready from not-full of R FIFO.

groups.name: write_cdc_fifos
groups.description: AW, W and B async FIFOs crossing write traffic between slave and master clocks.

groups.name: read_cdc_fifos
groups.description: AR and R async FIFOs crossing read traffic between clock domains.

groups.name: reset_synchronizer
groups.description: Shift register synchronizing reset release into master clock domain.
